newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy PSBR 11.58 trln lire in Nov 1996 - BankItaly.
newsitem.headline: Italy PSBR 11.58 trln lire in Nov 1996 - BankItaly.

text.p: Italy's state sector borrowing requirement for November 1996 was 11.581 trillion lire compared with 23.577 trillion in October and 19.881 trillion in November 1995, provisional data from the Bank of Italy said.
The Treasury deficit, net of payments and privatisation revenue, was 19.017 trillion in November against 20.049 trillion in October and 19.472 trillion in November 1995.
State sector debt in October was 2,202.113 trillion lire compared with 2,178.460 trillion in September and 2,075.819 trillion in October 1995.
